mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-ed86b5d8.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
        for a, b in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                if row[c] == 5:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
